column1: chef|/ʃef/|社会行业|n. 厨师|The chef cooked a simple meal that warmed everyone on the cold night.|厨师做了一顿简单的饭，温暖了寒夜里的每个人。
actor|/ˈæktə(r)/|社会行业|n. 演员|The actor rehearsed the sad speech until the whole room felt quiet.|演员排练悲伤的台词直到全场安静。
actress|/ˈæktrəs/|社会行业|n. 女演员|The young actress won praise for her role in the school play.|年轻女演员因在学校剧中的角色赢得称赞。
musician|/mjuˈzɪʃn/|社会行业|n. 音乐家|The street musician played a tune that made strangers stop and smile.|街头音乐家演奏的曲子让陌生人停下微笑。
painter|/ˈpeɪntə(r)/|社会行业|n. 画家|The painter mixed colours to show the light of an early morning.|画家调色以表现清晨的光。
architect|/ˈɑːkɪtekt/|社会行业|n. 建筑师|The architect designed a library that stayed cool without much power.|建筑师设计了一座无需太多电也凉爽的图书馆。
banker|/ˈbæŋkə(r)/|社会行业|n. 银行家|The banker explained how saving a little can grow over many years.|银行家解释了少量储蓄如何在多年后增长。
surgeon|/ˈsɜːdʒn/|社会行业|n. 外科医生|The surgeon operated for hours to repair the injured boy's hand.|外科医生手术数小时修复受伤男孩的手。
dentist|/ˈdentɪst/|社会行业|n. 牙医|The dentist taught us the right way to brush our teeth each day.|牙医教我们每天正确的刷牙方式。
pharmacist|/ˈfɑːməsɪst/|社会行业|n. 药剂师|The pharmacist checked the label before handing over the small bottle.|药剂师在递出小瓶前核对了标签。
mechanic|/məˈkænɪk/|社会行业|n. 技工|The mechanic repaired the old bus so the children could ride again.|技工修好旧巴士，孩子们又能乘车了。
electrician|/ɪˌlekˈtrɪʃn/|社会行业|n. 电工|The electrician fixed the broken light in the school science lab.|电工修好了学校科学实验室里坏掉的灯。
captain|/ˈkæptɪn/|社会行业|n. 船长|The captain guided the small boat safely through the stormy night.|船长引导小船安全度过风暴之夜。
sailor|/ˈseɪlə(r)/|社会行业|n. 水手|The old sailor told stories of the stars that guided him home.|老水手讲述指引他回家的星星的故事。
firefighter|/ˈfaɪəfaɪtə(r)/|社会行业|n. 消防员|The firefighter carried the child down the stairs without any fear.|消防员毫无畏惧地把孩子抱下楼梯。
tailor|/ˈteɪlə(r)/|社会行业|n. 裁缝|The tailor shortened the coat so it fit the small boy perfectly.|裁缝把外套改短，正好合小男孩身。
barber|/ˈbɑːbə(r)/|社会行业|n. 理发师|The barber chatted happily while he cut the grandfather's thin hair.|理发师一边高兴地聊天，一边剪爷爷稀疏的头发。
baker|/ˈbeɪkə(r)/|社会行业|n. 面包师|The baker woke before dawn to bake bread for the morning market.|面包师黎明前起床为早市烤面包。
butcher|/ˈbʊtʃə(r)/|社会行业|n. 屠夫|The butcher wrapped the meat and gave the dog a friendly bone.|屠夫包好肉，给狗一根友善的骨头。
merchant|/ˈmɜːtʃənt/|社会行业|n. 商人|The travelling merchant sold cloth in the villages along the river.|行商沿河各村售卖布匹。
grocer|/ˈɡrəʊsə(r)/|社会行业|n. 杂货商|The grocer let the hungry child take an apple when no one was looking.|杂货商趁无人注意让饥饿的孩子拿了个苹果。
cashier|/kæˈʃɪə(r)/|社会行业|n. 收银员|The cashier counted the coins and smiled at the tired old man.|收银员数着硬币，对疲惫的老人微笑。
receptionist|/rɪˈsepʃənɪst/|社会行业|n. 接待员|The receptionist welcomed the guests with a calm and helpful voice.|接待员用平静而有帮助的声音欢迎客人。
secretary|/ˈsekrətri/|社会行业|n. 秘书|The secretary organised the meeting and typed the long report quickly.|秘书组织了会议并快速打好了长篇报告。
manager|/ˈmænɪdʒə(r)/|社会行业|n. 经理|The manager trained the new workers to use the coffee machine well.|经理培训新工人好好使用咖啡机。
colleague|/ˈkɒliːɡ/|社会行业|n. 同事|My colleague covered my shift when I fell ill last winter.|去年冬天我生病时同事替了我的班。
profession|/prəˈfeʃn/|社会行业|n. 职业|Teaching is a profession that shapes the future of a whole society.|教学是塑造整个社会未来的职业。
occupation|/ˌɒkjuˈpeɪʃn/|社会行业|n. 职业|Her occupation as a nurse taught her patience with worried families.|她作为护士的职业教会她对忧心家庭有耐心。
commerce|/ˈkɒmɜːs/|社会行业|n. 商业|Online commerce lets a small shop sell goods far across the country.|在线商业让小店能把货卖到全国远方。
manufacturing|/ˌmænjuˈfæktʃərɪŋ/|社会行业|n. 制造业|Manufacturing in the town provides jobs for many local young people.|镇上的制造业为许多本地青年提供工作。
tourism|/ˈtʊərɪzəm/|社会行业|n. 旅游业|Tourism brought new restaurants and clean roads to the quiet island.|旅游业给宁静的岛屿带来了新餐馆与整洁道路。
retail|/ˈriːteɪl/|社会行业|n. 零售|Retail shops stayed open late during the festival week in the city.|节日周里城里的零售店营业到很晚。
finance|/ˈfaɪnæns/|社会行业|n. 金融|He studied finance so he could help families plan for later life.|他学金融以便帮助家庭规划日后生活。
banking|/ˈbæŋkɪŋ/|社会行业|n. 银行业|Banking has changed since people began to pay with their phones.|自人们开始用手机付款，银行业改变了。
insurance|/ɪnˈʃʊərəns/|社会行业|n. 保险|Insurance helped the family rebuild the house after the flood came.|保险在洪水后帮助这家人重建了房屋。
investment|/ɪnˈvestmənt/|社会行业|n. 投资|The wise investment in solar panels lowered the school's bills.|对太阳能板的明智投资降低了学校的开支。
employment|/ɪmˈplɔɪmənt/|社会行业|n. 就业|Employment in the green industry is growing faster than before.|绿色行业的就业比以往增长更快。
workshop|/ˈwɜːkʃɒp/|社会行业|n. 车间|The wood workshop smelled of sawdust as we built a small chair.|我们做小椅子时木工车间弥漫着木屑味。
factory|/ˈfæktri/|社会行业|n. 工厂|The factory near the river closed after it moved the work abroad.|河边的工厂把工作移到国外后关闭了。
corporation|/ˌkɔːpəˈreɪʃn/|社会行业|n. 公司|The corporation donated computers to the rural school last autumn.|这家公司去年秋天向乡村学校捐赠了电脑。
enterprise|/ˈentəpraɪz/|社会行业|n. 企业|The small enterprise grew from a kitchen table to a busy city office.|这家小企业从厨房餐桌发展成繁忙的城市办公室。
accountant|/əˈkaʊntənt/|社会行业|n. 会计|The accountant checked the numbers twice before sending the yearly report.|会计在发送年度报告前把数字核对了两遍。
consultant|/kənˈsʌltənt/|社会行业|n. 顾问|The consultant advised the school on how to save energy each day.|顾问就学校每日节能提供了建议。
technician|/tekˈnɪʃn/|社会行业|n. 技术员|The technician fixed the server so the class could join the video lesson.|技术员修好服务器，班级得以加入视频课。
librarian|/laɪˈbreəriən/|社会行业|n. 图书管理员|The librarian helped me find a book about stars beyond our planet.|图书管理员帮我找到一本关于地球外星辰的书。
vendor|/ˈvendə(r)/|社会行业|n. 小贩|The street vendor sold warm peanuts to the crowd after the late match.|街头小贩在深夜比赛后向人群卖热花生。
craftsman|/ˈkrɑːftsmən/|社会行业|n. 工匠|The old craftsman carved a spoon from a single piece of pale wood.|老工匠用一块浅色木头雕出一把勺子。
apprenticeship|/əˈprentɪʃɪp/|社会行业|n. 学徒期|He learned the trade through a long apprenticeship with a kind master.|他通过和善良师傅的长期学徒期学会了这门手艺。
internship|/ˈɪntɜːnʃɪp/|社会行业|n. 实习|The summer internship taught her how a hospital really runs each day.|暑期实习教她医院每天实际如何运转。
workforce|/ˈwɜːkfɔːs/|社会行业|n. 劳动力|The local workforce welcomed the new train that carried them to town.|本地劳动力欢迎载他们进城的新火车。
consumer|/kənˈsjuːmə(r)/|社会行业|n. 消费者|The careful consumer read the label before buying the cheap phone.|谨慎的消费者在购买便宜手机前读了标签。
client|/ˈklaɪənt/|社会行业|n. 客户|The lawyer listened closely to the quiet client in the small office.|律师在小办公室里仔细倾听安静的客户。
supplier|/səˈplaɪə(r)/|社会行业|n. 供应商|The supplier delivered fresh vegetables to the school kitchen each dawn.|供应商每天黎明把新鲜蔬菜送到学校厨房。
competitor|/kəmˈpetɪtə(r)/|社会行业|n. 竞争者|Our competitor opened a cafe just across the narrow street from ours.|我们的竞争者在街对面开了家咖啡馆。
partnership|/ˈpɑːtnəʃɪp/|社会行业|n. 合伙|The partnership between the school and farm grew healthy cheap food.|学校与农场的合伙种出了健康便宜的食物。
distribution|/ˌdɪstrɪˈbjuːʃn/|社会行业|n. 分销|The distribution of books reached even the most remote village school.|图书的分销甚至到达了最偏远的乡村学校。
logistics|/ləˈdʒɪstɪks/|社会行业|n. 物流|Good logistics kept the vaccines cold all the way to the clinic.|良好的物流让疫苗一路冷链送到诊所。
revenue|/ˈrevənjuː/|社会行业|n. 收入|The market's revenue rose after the new subway station opened nearby.|新地铁站附近开通后市场的收入上升了。
profit|/ˈprɒfɪt/|社会行业|n. 利润|The small profit was shared fairly among the workers who made it.|微薄的利润在创造它的工人间公平分配。
broker|/ˈbrəʊkə(r)/|社会行业|n. 经纪人|The broker found a small flat for the family moving to the city.|经纪人为搬进城里的家庭找到了小公寓。
curator|/kjʊəˈreɪtə(r)/|社会行业|n. 策展人|The curator arranged the photos to tell a story of the old port.|策展人布置照片讲述老港口的故事。
intern|/ˈɪntɜːn/|社会行业|n. 实习生|The intern fetched coffee and learned how a newsroom really works.|实习生取咖啡的同时了解了编辑部如何运作。
trainee|/treɪˈniː/|社会行业|n. 受训者|The new trainee shadowed a nurse through a busy morning in the ward.|新受训者跟着护士在繁忙的清晨查病房。
apprentice|/əˈprentɪs/|社会行业|n. 学徒|The apprentice watched closely as the jeweller set the small bright stone.|学徒紧盯着珠宝匠镶嵌小亮石。
broadcast|/ˈbrɔːdkɑːst/|传媒法治|n. 广播|The morning broadcast shared news about the clean river project nearby.|早晨的广播分享了附近清河项目的新闻。
journalism|/ˈdʒɜːnəlɪzəm/|传媒法治|n. 新闻业|Good journalism asks hard questions and checks every fact twice.|好的新闻业提出尖锐问题并核对每件事两次。
journalist|/ˈdʒɜːnəlɪst/|传媒法治|n. 记者|The journalist interviewed the farmer about the lost wetland birds.|记者采访了农夫关于消失的湿地鸟。
newspaper|/ˈnjuːzpeɪpə(r)/|传媒法治|n. 报纸|The local newspaper printed our letter about the unsafe crossroad.|地方报纸刊登了我们关于危险路口的信。
website|/ˈwebsaɪt/|传媒法治|n. 网站|The school website posted photos from the spring sports meeting.|学校网站贴出了春季运动会的照片。
internet|/ˈɪntənet/|传媒法治|n. 互联网|The internet helped the class research the history of the old bridge.|互联网帮全班研究老桥的历史。
platform|/ˈplætfɔːm/|传媒法治|n. 平台|The video platform let students share experiments from their own homes.|视频平台让学生分享自家的实验。
social|/ˈsəʊʃl/|传媒法治|adj. 社会的|Social media can spread both kindness and harmful false rumours quickly.|社交媒体能迅速传播善意也有害的谣言。
blog|/blɒɡ/|传媒法治|n. 博客|Her blog about city birds attracted readers from many far countries.|她关于城市鸟的博客吸引了多国读者。
podcast|/ˈpɒdkɑːst/|传媒法治|n. 播客|The weekly podcast explained science using simple clear stories.|每周播客用简单清晰的故事讲解科学。
editor|/ˈedɪtə(r)/|传媒法治|n. 编辑|The editor cut the long article to fit the small front page space.|编辑删减长文以适配头版的小空间。
column|/ˈkɒləm/|传媒法治|n. 专栏|Her column in the paper discussed life at a crowded city school.|她在报上的专栏讨论拥挤城市学校的生活。
editorial|/ˌedɪˈtɔːriəl/|传媒法治|n. 社论|The editorial urged the city to plant more trees along the roads.|社论敦促城市沿路种更多树。
propaganda|/ˌprɒpəˈɡændə/|传媒法治|n. 宣传|Propaganda during the war often hid the truth from ordinary people.|战争时期的宣传常对普通人隐瞒真相。
constitution|/ˌkɒnstɪˈtjuːʃn/|传媒法治|n. 宪法|The constitution protects the basic rights of every citizen in the land.|宪法保护这片土地上每位公民的基本权利。
courtroom|/ˈkɔːtruːm/|传媒法治|n. 法庭|The quiet courtroom filled with people as the trial was about to start.|随着审判临近，安静的法庭挤满了人。
judge|/dʒʌdʒ/|传媒法治|n. 法官|The judge listened carefully before deciding who was truly at fault.|法官仔细聆听后才判定谁真的有错。
jury|/ˈdʒʊəri/|传媒法治|n. 陪审团|The jury discussed the evidence for a long and quiet afternoon.|陪审团安静地讨论了漫长的下午的证据。
defendant|/dɪˈfendənt/|传媒法治|n. 被告|The defendant explained where he was on the night of the fire.|被告解释了火灾那夜他在哪里。
testify|/ˈtestɪfaɪ/|传媒法治|v. 作证|The witness agreed to testify about what she saw near the bank.|证人同意就她在银行附近所见作证。
punishment|/ˈpʌnɪʃmənt/|传媒法治|n. 惩罚|The punishment was a fine and a long talk with the school council.|惩罚是罚款并与校委会长谈。
prison|/ˈprɪzn/|传媒法治|n. 监狱|The old prison was turned into a museum about the town's past.|旧监狱被改成了关于镇史的博物馆。
guilty|/ˈɡɪlti/|传媒法治|adj. 有罪的|The jury found the man guilty after hearing all the clear evidence.|听完全部清晰证据后陪审团判该男子有罪。
innocent|/ˈɪnəsnt/|传媒法治|adj. 无辜的|The innocent student was wrongly blamed for the broken window glass.|无辜的学生被错怪打破了窗玻璃。
accuse|/əˈkjuːz/|传媒法治|v. 指控|Do not accuse a friend without first hearing the full story calmly.|没有先平静听完全部故事前不要指控朋友。
arrest|/əˈrest/|传媒法治|v. 逮捕|The police arrested the thief who stole bikes near the station.|警方逮捕了在车站附近偷自行车的贼。
sue|/suː/|传媒法治|v. 起诉|The family decided to sue the company for the polluted local river.|这家人决定为公司污染本地河起诉。
lawsuit|/ˈlɔːsuːt/|传媒法治|n. 诉讼|The long lawsuit ended when the factory agreed to pay for the damage.|当工厂同意赔偿损害，漫长诉讼结束。
treaty|/ˈtriːti/|传媒法治|n. 条约|The two nations signed a treaty to protect the shared mountain lake.|两国签署条约保护共有的山湖。
government|/ˈɡʌvənmənt/|传媒法治|n. 政府|The local government opened a free clinic for the neighbourhood's poor.|地方政府为社区穷人开了免费诊所。
parliament|/ˈpɑːləmənt/|传媒法治|n. 议会|Parliament debated the new law on clean air for several long days.|议会就清洁空气新法辩论了数个长日。
democracy|/dɪˈmɒkrəsi/|传媒法治|n. 民主|Democracy works best when citizens take part in local decisions.|当公民参与本地决策时民主运转最好。
election|/ɪˈlekʃn/|传媒法治|n. 选举|The school election taught us how a fair vote should really work.|学校选举教我们公平投票应如何运作。
vote|/vəʊt/|传媒法治|v. 投票|We will vote for the plan that helps the most students in need.|我们将投票给最能帮助困难学生的计划。
candidate|/ˈkændɪdət/|传媒法治|n. 候选人|Each candidate gave a short speech about safer roads for children.|每位候选人就儿童更安全的道路作了短演讲。
authority|/ɔːˈθɒrəti/|传媒法治|n. 权威|The health authority warned the city about the dirty well water.|卫生当局就脏井水警告了全市。
citizen|/ˈsɪtɪzn/|传媒法治|n. 公民|A good citizen obeys the law and helps neighbours in quiet ways.|好公民守法并以安静的方式帮助邻居。
liberty|/ˈlɪbəti/|传媒法治|n. 自由|The poem celebrated the liberty of speaking one's mind without fear.|这首诗赞颂了无畏直言的自由。
justice|/ˈdʒʌstɪs/|传媒法治|n. 正义|The community demanded justice for the family that lost the small shop.|社区为失去小店的家庭要求正义。
equality|/iˈkwɒləti/|传媒法治|n. 平等|Equality in education gives every child a fair chance to shine.|教育平等给每个孩子公平发光的机会。
legislature|/ˈledʒɪsleɪtʃə(r)/|传媒法治|n. 立法机构|The legislature passed a rule to ban plastic bags in the market.|立法机构通过规则在市场禁用塑料袋。
senator|/ˈsenətə(r)/|传媒法治|n. 参议员|The senator visited the school to listen to young people's worries.|参议员访问学校倾听年轻人的忧虑。
mayor|/meə(r)/|传媒法治|n. 市长|The mayor pledged to fix the broken streetlights before the winter came.|市长承诺在冬天前修好坏掉的路灯。
ministry|/ˈmɪnɪstri/|传媒法治|n. 部委|The ministry announced a plan to plant trees in every bare schoolyard.|部委宣布在每所光秃校园种树的计划。
embassy|/ˈembəsi/|传媒法治|n. 大使馆|The embassy helped the lost tourist contact his family back home.|大使馆帮迷路游客联系家乡的家人。
ambassador|/æmˈbæsədə(r)/|传媒法治|n. 大使|The ambassador promoted culture exchange between the two friendly cities.|大使促进两座友好城市间的文化交流。
diplomacy|/dɪˈpləʊməsi/|传媒法治|n. 外交|Diplomacy prevented a small border fight from growing into a war.|外交阻止了小规模边界冲突升级为战争。
